name: dual-pump-pid-trainer
description: Browser simulator of two parallel VFD centrifugal pumps on a common header under PID control: pump and system curves, NPSH and cavitation, motor and drive dynamics, lead/lag staging with duty rotation and sleep, cascade, feedforward and override strategies, relay/step/sweep identification with ranked tuning rules, Bode and Nyquist analysis, loop-health diagnostics including a Harris index and stiction detection, a fourteen-lesson curriculum and a graded scorecard.
